text:
This issue is caused by model normalization rewriting your DeepSeek model identifier.

### Cause
In `hermes_cli/model_normalize.py`, the function `_normalize_for_deepseek()` force-normalizes `deepseek-v4-flash` to `deepseek-chat`. The DeepSeek API maps `deepseek-chat` to `deepseek-v4-pro`, which leads to higher-than-expected token charges. 

You can confirm this by checking your `agent.log` for:
```text
Normalized model 'deepseek-v4-flash' to 'deepseek-chat'
```

### Solution
To prevent Hermes from rewriting the model name:
1. Open `hermes_cli/model_normalize.py`.
2. Add both `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` to the `_DEEPSEEK_CANONICAL_MODELS` list.
